schema.fractalProperty: Le même motif se répète à chaque profondeur — Modularis → Luna → Nucleus → Crystal
schema.phiClustering: Les événements liés se rapprochent naturellement selon le ratio PHI
schema.symmetryAsError: Une asymétrie dans la structure géométrique = erreur détectable visuellement

content.doc: Geometric Memory organizes the event log as a fractal tree instead of a flat list. Events cluster by self-similarity (same templateId, same artifactId, same source). The tree branches at PHI ratio — naturally efficient, no manual sorting needed. Symmetry (0.0–1.0) measures structural coherence at each node. A symmetry below 0.7 (the same threshold as CanResonate at 639 Hz) marks a visible error — the geometry breaks before the text is even read. This is the connection between sacred geometry and diagnostic precision: the brain detects the asymmetry faster than it reads the log.
